scope: Idle PostgreSQL migration combined cluster/database loss with durable result delivery on Kubernetes 1.37.0 linux/amd64.
cleanup: Both dedicated clusters and owned database resources are absent in independent Docker readback.
limitations: One development recovery case; the other declared engine/family/loss/timing rows remain required.
The host reports 15979683840 bytes of RAM, below the frozen 16 GiB profile minimum; measured timing is a development result.
Bootstrap retains 64Mi kubelet logs. This record does not satisfy the separate default-10Mi logging requirement.

The new installation has new trust, journal, enrollment and resource UIDs. Original result bindings remain archived, not rewritten as new authority. Exact storage restoration is covered separately by result-backup-restore-2026-10-02.
Encrypted backups and keys remain locally restricted pending durable-store and custody acceptance. Temporary registries were removed and are not a portable recovery kit.

priorFailure.stage: Enable source result delivery before backup or loss injection
priorFailure.cause: Bootstrap shell exit closed the source API SSH tunnel; Helm could not connect to 127.0.0.1:31817.
priorFailure.fix: The recovery procedure owns any required replacement tunnel, validates its exact recorded forwarding endpoint, and marks pre-backup failures terminal.
